name: The Token Company
what: Compression model and API middleware that deletes low-value tokens from LLM prompts to cut cost and latency.
homonym_note: Same company as the y-combinator book's row (YC W26).

membership.basis: Listed on the live visionaries.vc portfolio (2026); not on the 2023-2025 captures, so a recent position.
membership.quote: The Token Company – Compress LLM input

notes: No source ties Visionaries to a round. Nordic9 (2025-12-04) names only Wave Ventures, Inception Fund and local angels in a ~$500k pre-seed; the company site names Y Combinator and founder angels (Hugging Face, Silo AI, Supercell, Dropbox, Slack). A web-search summary claimed a $10.3M seed led by Primary Venture Partners with Visionaries, but no page carrying that claim could be found or fetched, so it is not recorded. Google News ('"The Token Company"', '"Token Company" Visionaries', '"Token Company" YC', '"Otso Veisterä"', '"Token Company" Primary Venture') found nothing; the Newcomer 2026-04-02 YC scoop is paywalled. Nordic9 describes the company as Swedish at pre-seed; YC lists San Francisco.
